SHRI LAVU SRIKRISHNA DEVARAYALU (NARASARAOPET): Hon. Speaker, thank you for the opportunity to present my Motion of Thanks on the hon. President?s Speech.

There are many praiseworthy remarks made by the hon. President in her speech. The Government has focused on multidimensional development of the country in the last few years and India has certainly seen tremendous growth on multiple fronts. But I would like to highlight some areas where the Government has performed poorly.

Let me begin with Government?s mantra of ?Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas?. In Para 4, hon. President heralded this mantra to be an inspiration for building a developed India. The people of Andhra Pradesh have felt excluded from this mantra.

For the last eight years, we have been demanding that Andhra Pradesh be granted ?Special Category Status? in light of the unscientific and unjust bifurcation of the State of Andhra Pradesh which has left the State financially handicapped. SCS status would provide AP a higher share of Government of India grants along with major tax incentives that will help alleviate the financial burden on the State. Similarly, the net borrowing limit for Andhra Pradesh has been cut indiscriminately by a whopping Rs. 17,923.24 crore due to overborrowing by the State during the early years of the previous Government. This has further hampered the State?s fiscal position.

I would also like to point out that the Polavaram Irrigation Project found no mention in the President?s Speech and this has been a long pending demand of the people of Andhra, legally enshrined in the AP Reorganization Act, 2014.

In para 7, hon. President highlighted that India has been able to give a befitting response to every misadventure from LoC to LAC. However, this is far from reality.

India?s response to PLA?s advancements into our territory has been diffident. As per reports, India has lost access to 26 out of 65 patrolling points from the Karakoram Pass to Chumar along the Line of Actual Control (LAC) in Ladakh. This technically implies that we have ceded some of our territory to China?s control. The Government of India has been unable to defuse the 33-month long border crisis with China.

India?s trade deficit with China has shot up by 50 per cent in just one year. It now accounts for 64 per cent of its overall trade deficit. The rising imports from China are contrary to the Government?s vision of ?Think Global, Act Local? and Atmanirbhar Bharat.

Considering India constitutes about 11.5 per cent of China?s overall trade surplus, efforts must be taken to reduce our dependence on Chinese imports. This will enable India to use economic leverage as a tool to defuse the border crisis and curtail China?s growing influence in the neighbourhood.

The Economic Survey has highlighted that despite a significant increase in Government?s share of spending on health over the last 7-8 years, out of pocket spending on health by a citizen is still high.

I commend the hon. President for highlighting the role of Ayushman Bharat Yojana in making quality healthcare accessible to the poor, in Para 16. It was mentioned that 50 crore people are benefiting from the scheme. But as per the statistics, only 21.9 crore beneficiaries have been verified so far which is 50 per cent of the targeted 50 crore beneficiaries under the scheme. The hon. President has rightly pointed out in Para 16 that a major cause of poverty is illness. Hence, it is important the remaining eligible beneficiaries are verified and included under the scheme as soon as possible to save millions of poor from incurring out of pocket expenditure on health.

Promises are also being made that every district will have a medical college, as mentioned by hon. President in Para 39. The Andhra Pradesh State has only 14 Government medical colleges as of now. It has been demanding to build 13 new medical colleges in the 13 new districts that were created in April 2022. The State is constructing 17 medical colleges and is seeking more Central support in this endeavour.

It is concerning to note that not enough was mentioned about education except passing remarks on Eklavya Model Schools and the increase in number of universities in the country.

Hon. President mentioned in Para 26 that 400 Eklavya Model Schools have opened in tribal areas of the country. But the reality is construction of 100 schools had only begun by April 2022. The Standing Committee on Social Justice and Empowerment found out that out of the 452 new Eklavya Model Schools sanctioned, work on 332 schools was scheduled to begin by March 2022. These figures portray a dismal picture.

Tribal communities comprise over 7 per cent of the Andhra population, but 30 Eklavya Model Schools are concentrated in only 8 out of 26 districts. Backwards districts like Palnadu inhabit a large number of ST population that still await access to quality education. Eklavya Model Residential Schools should be established in all tribal districts of the State with proper infrastructure and availability of teachers.

The total number of schools in India have reduced in the last few years. As per estimates, between 2013-14 and 2021-22, total number of schools dropped from 15.2 lakh to 14.9 lakh. Primary and upper primary schools alone saw a reduction of one lakh schools. Focusing on the education of children especially in their formative years is critical for India?s long term development prospects.

In Para 66, there was a mention about Government?s major strides in opening up new Universities in the last eight years. I appreciate the Government for its concerted focus on improving the higher education sector.

However, the implementation of Institutions of National Importance (INIs) that were promised to Andhra Pradesh in the AP Reorganisation Act has been abysmally slow. Most Universities are operating from rented campuses and are facing a severe staff shortage. Shortage of funds has been cited as a major roadblock. The Central University of Andhra Pradesh (CUAP) was allocated Rs. 56.66 crore in Budget 2022-23 of which only Rs. 13.08 crore got used.

In Para 69, hon. President mentioned about the role of Udan Yojana in making India the third largest aviation market in the world. It is truly a proud moment for the country that number of airports have almost doubled from 74 in 2014 to 147 today. But it seems the benefits of the Udan Yojana have not reached the State of Andhra Pradesh. Andhra Pradesh has five airports, out of which three of them are international airports including Tirupati, Vijaywada and Vizag. But they are not connected even to the major cities of the country. To give you an example, there are no direct flights to Mumbai from Vijaywada and Tirupati despite being international airports. I have flagged this issue multiple times in the Parliament but no significant progress has been made.

Hon. President ? in paragraph 59 ? has highlighted the performance of India start-ups. It is a shining example of India?s entrepreneurial spirit and enterprise capacity. However, I would like to caution this House about possible risks attached with certain accounting and regulatory practices of these start-ups.

Start-ups have transited towards higher valuations (with opaque computations) rather than building sturdy business foundations that generate perpetual value. Recently, numerous billion-dollar start-ups like Byjus backed by illustrious global investors have struggled to explain accounting lapses. Such murky accounting and corporate governance practices undertaken by new-age start-ups does not bode well for the long-term economic prospects of the country.

Further, the SEBI has made it simpler for loss making start-ups to access public markets and list themselves. In the past 2-3 years, multiple start-ups have exercised this route to get their entities listed at inexplicable valuations. Overtime, the market has ensured that the share prices of these start-ups settle at their fair-value but this has resulted in retail investors suffering substantial erosion of wealth while institutional investors have exited after making handsome gains. It is hereby requested that SEBI and the relevant authorities device a mechanism wherein retail investors are adequately protected from such situations and also go a long way to make India a credible securities and capital market.

In Para 30, hon. President emphasized about the present Government?s efforts to bring about emancipation of women in the society. However, these claims sound hollow on most counts. The number of rape cases reported as per the records of the National Crime Records Bureau suggest that there has been a year-on-year increase from 2020 and 2021.

On the women?s health front, the hon. President highlighted in Para 33 the work done under the various schemes of Women and Child Development Ministry. It is important to note that their flagship scheme PMMVY (Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana) has had nearly 7.6 crores applications which has converted to approximately 3.2 crores beneficiaries, thus highlighting the dismal conversion rate.

Much has been said about the upliftment of disadvantaged communities including the poor, Scheduled Tribes, Scheduled Castes and Other Backward Castes.

Hon. President highlighted the importance of the PM SVANidhi scheme in Para 24 which came to the rescue of lakhs of street vendors across the country who suffered ? and continue to ? suffer due to pandemic. However, the disbursal rate of loans under the scheme has been appallingly poor. In the first nine months of 2020, banks disbursed loans to more than 20 lakh street vendors of Rs. 10,000 each. But, in the subsequent year ? 2021 ? nine lakh street vendors were given loan. Until September, 2022, loans to only two lakh street vendors had been disbursed.

One of the reasons for decline in demand is that the amount of Rs. 10,000 (1st tranche), Rs. 20,000 (2nd tranche) and Rs. 50,000 (3rd tranche) is too meagre and there have been demands for doubling the loan amount. Many eligible street vendors are also facing issues in getting Vending Certificates from the Town Vending Committees.

Hon. President mentioned in Para 23 about the steps taken by the Government to fulfil the wishes of the tribal communities.

But malnutrition rate among tribal communities is still very high in the country. As per the 2015-16 NFHS survey, among children (under five years) belonging to Scheduled Tribes, 43.8 per cent are stunted, 27.4 per cent are wasted and 45.3 per cent are underweight. Other developing economies like Bangladesh, South Africa, Sri Lanka, Mexico and Brazil are doing way better and are taking proactive measures to reduce malnutrition rates among their lowest income populations.

Nearly half of the total children enrolled in schools in tribal areas, 48.2 per cent drop out even before they complete Class 8. More targeted Government interventions are required for all-rounded development of tribal communities.

Hon. President mentioned in Para 47 that hundreds of modern Vande Bharat trains are being launched. But only eight such trains have been operationalised so far which is far from the intended target of 400 Vande Bharat Trains by 2025. People of Andhra Pradesh have been demanding that a Vande Bharat train be introduced between Secundrabad and Tirupati via Piduguralla and Guntur as lakhs of pilgrims travel to the temple town of Tirupati, majorly from the Secunderabad region in Telangana. There is also a greater need for a Vande Bharat train along the Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor (VCIC) to provide a major boost to the manufacturing and services sector and fulfil the objectives of the Make in India initiative.

The hon. President commended the Government for its various initiatives in the railways sector. However, it is felt that these positives have come at the cost of the regular continuing services. A large number of services have been discontinued on a pan-India level while certain critical services are not being extended primarily to Andhra Pradesh.

Guntur, which is a principal railway station struggles with connections to key western cities and economic centers such as Jaipur and Ahmedabad. Both Guntur and Narsaraopet are now important district centers and hence, trains originating from Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam should cross through this route to ease the needs of the local population.

It is with great distress that I have to state that the South Coastal Railway Zone, which has been promised to Andhra Pradesh is yet to take off. The Detailed Project Report for it has been issued. The SCOR Zone with its headquarters in Vishakhapatnam is yet to operationalize even though, the Railway Board had also sanctioned 106 crore for the construction of the SCOR zonal headquarters building.

It is disheartening to note that hon. President did not mention anything to assuage the aqua exporters of AP. The CAGR of aqua exports of AP stands at 9.5 per cent which is above the national average of 7 per cent, making AP the largest aqua exporter in India. However, the industry has taken a severe blow in the last few months.

Although hon. Finance Minister?s decision to reduce duty on exports of shrimps is a step in the right direction, this may not be enough. To secure the long-term stability of the aqua industry, the Government should actively pursue China to reinstate the suspended factories in India. Greater push is required for export of value-added products by increasing the Remission of Duties and Taxes on Exported Products (RoDTEP), which has been recommended by MPEDA as well. India must also sign Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) particularly with EU, UK and South Korea to make Indian seafood compete with other exporting countries.

The Government has proudly highlighted the construction of rural and urban houses under the PM-AWAS Yojana and this has been spoken about by the hon. President as well in Para 18. It was further highlighted how a house with facilities such as cooking gas, toilet and electricity aids in developing self-confidence. However, as per the CAG reports of 2020 and 2021, it was found that the houses constructed under this scheme suffered from poor construction quality as well as lacking basic amenities such as functional toilets. Additionally, Ministry of Rural Development had set a target of constructing close to three crore houses, off which 2.12 crore have been completed which signifies that nearly 30 per cent of the houses sanctioned have not been built.

Another important point to note here, LPG gas prices have increased from Rs. 400 in 2015 to more than Rs. 1,100 in 2022 and data suggests that 40 per cent of the households with LPG connections have fallen off the radar due to exponential increase in LPG prices.

In Para 45, the hon. President highlighted the Government?s emphasis on scientific agricultural support to our farmers. However, the Government has not kept its word when it comes to my State of Andhra Pradesh. Under the Agriculture Ministry, the plan was to set-up a Krishi Vigyan Kendra which would assist in transferring of scientific technologies to the farming community at the district level. The State of Andhra Pradesh has been reorganized with 26 districts. The Government has indicated no enthusiasm to set up additional KVKs in these new districts including my own district, Palnadu.

In Para 81, the hon. President ends her speech with a dictum of Veda which calls for unity in resolutions. The President rightly mentions we all should walk together step by step. But the Government needs to put this dictum into practice and walk together with States like Andhra Pradesh to preserve the federal structure of the nation. Development can only take place when everyone is taken along in this journey of nation building.

Thank you.

SHRI V.K. SREEKANDAN (PALAKKAD): I would like to express my views on the motion of thanks on the Hon'ble President's address. The Presidential address normally covers some of the most important performance of the government achieved in the outgoing financial year and incidents that happened during the said period and what the government intends to do in the next financial year as this customary presidential address commensurate with the budget of the government for the ensuing financial year. But I must say that this address does not focus on what the government intends to do in the ensuing financial year. The address is just like a progress report on a student for the parents to vouch on their child.

When this Government came to power in the year 2014, it was assured the nation that the crime against women will be taken care of to reduce. But what happened was that the crime against women has been steadily increasing since then year after year and is going on unabated and according to the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB), crime against women is happening the most in most of the year since 2014 is in the double engine sarkar of Uttar Pradesh. Not only this, in another State which is Gujarat where also the double engine sarkar is existing, the Government there freed 11 convicts of Gujarat gang rape from jail in Gujarat's Godhra town after the state Government approved their application for remission of sentence. So, this is the reality. Talks something for the consumption of the general public and contradictory things happen. But this address does not say anything about the prevention of crimes against women.

Unemployment is a big issue the nation is facing. The unemployment level has surpassed all previous records and the youths of our country are losing hope even after attaining higher degrees or qualifications. The unemployment rate in urban areas increased to 10.09% in December, 2022 It is predicted to rise in the next few years. The wrong implementation of Goods and Services Tax and demonetization forced closure of job generating avenues which made our youths to roam here and there in search of jobs. But in this address, it is saying nothing on the creation of jobs. India is considered as a nation of youths, and if their hope is shattered, mere slogans will not work.

The country has been witnessing continued increase in the price of all essential commodities and the poorer section of our population is mostly affected on this account. On the other hand, the reduced income due to reduction in jobs and on the other side high cost of all essential commodities, all these made the life of the poor miserable and the address does not show any concern towards them.

The price on petrol and diesel have nearly doubled since the year 2014 and whereas the international price on crude oil reduced by half per barrel. The reduced international price of crude oil has no bearing effect on the prices by which petrol and diesel are being sold in India. The present record price on diesel has led to an increase in the cost of all essential commodities.

In the case of cooking LPG Gas, the price of the same has been tripled to nearly Rs.1200 per cylinder and whereas the same was available at Rs. 400 or so when the United Progressive Alliance government was there till May, 2014. Due to this exorbitant cost of cooking gas the households are facing acute problems and are unable to meet both the ends. Even the beneficiaries of Ujala scheme were not able to refill the second cylinders. But in this address, these have no place, showing no concern.

The farmers who are the annadhathas of our nation have been demanding guaranteed Minimum Support Price for their produce. It was assured to them that this issue will be addressed, to call off their year long strike in the national capital. But these farmers now feel that they have been cheated and the government has gone back on its promise. Their demand for guaranteed Minimum Support Price was based on the fact that the cost of all input materials such as fertilizers, etc and the labour charges wherever required have gone up drastically and there is even a proposal to withdraw or reduce subsidy on fertilizer due to budget deficit as well as on international pressures. Therefore, the farmers fear that the cost of farming will go up to a level which cannot be affordable for small and marginal farmers. But in this address, there has been no mention of guaranteed Minimum Support Price, except saying setting up of Farmer Producer Organisations, but the fact is that such an organization is already existing for the same purpose in the name of Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices.

Most of the political parties and experts have been demanding a debate on the aggression by China at the Line of Actual Control, but the government is not willing to do so. There are reports that the Chinese Army PLA is very much inside our territory in some pockets. The locals in Arunachal Pradesh have been complaining about this. The clashes between our soldiers and the Chinese army have been reported quite often. We lost our 20 brave soldiers at the hands of the Chinese army in Galwan valley earlier. China is creating all types of infrastructure at the LoAC. Even we were warned by world countries on this issue. But I am sorry to say nothing has been elaborated in detail in the address.

Another issue which I would like to deal with here is about unemployment again. There are nearly posts vacant in central government departments. In Railway alone 3.12 lakh posts are lying vacant. Merely distributing appointment or offer letters to a few thousands of job seekers is of no solution when the backlog is huge. But this address does not say anything when the government is going to fill up these vacancies running into several lakhs.

Due to implementation of policies without consulting the State governments, several State governments are facing huge fiscal stress, forcing many developmental projects halted and social welfare schemes to be put on hold, but at the same time the States are not allowed to borrow money beyond a limit. States had to approach the Central government to allow them to borrow money to run their government. Again, this serious issue found no place in the address.

Millions of people are living adjoining protected forests that are national parks or wildlife sanctuaries from time immemorial with all legal rights. But now they live in fear on account of Eco Sensitive Zone of one kilometre from demarcated boundary. The people have been demanding especially people living in such places in Kerala zero buffer zone as the one kilometre criteria will make them homeless and business establishments that are giving livelihood for them have to be smashed, not only these, many religious structures have also to be removed, in addition to losing agricultural lands. However, no mention has been made in this address concerning millions of people.

There are reports of starvation and perhaps the implementation of PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana was an attestation of it. Merely distributing a few kilograms of foodgrains cannot eradicate poverty. The government has to take some steps to ensure the prosperity of the poorer section that amounts to a lion share of our population, but this address has no mention of it.

Finally on the health front, I would like to mention that the government was talking about eradicating TB in our country. But the actual fact is that this deadly disease is now enlarging rapidly. Similarly, many new types of diseases are reported across the country one after the other. But this address does not say how the government plans to eradicate disease like TB and to control new diseases that are appearing one after the other.

KUMARI GODDETI MADHAVI (ARAKU): At the outset, I would like to express my views on motion of thanks on hon. President address. I feel extremely proud, as a Member from the Tribal Community, that a fellow Member from my community has occupied the highest constitutional post in our country. I am equally thankful to the hon. President for mentioning the following points in the speech. It is highly commendable that the country has started celebrating the birth anniversary of Bhagwan Birsa Munda as ?Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas'. The Government paying tribute to the tribal revolutionaries at the national level in Mangarh Dham for the first time is a significant move. Today, more than 36,000 tribal dominated villages are being developed under the Pradhan Mantri Adi Adarsh Gram Yojana. Also, more than 400 Eklavya Model Schools have opened in tribal areas in the country. More than 3,000 Van Dhan Vikas Kendras have become new means of livelihood across the country. My Government has demonstrated its commitment to the welfare of OBCs by giving constitutional status to the National Commission for Backward Classes. For the first time, a Welfare and Development Board has also been constituted for the banjara, nomadic and semi-nomadic communities. 

I would like to congratulate the Government for the above initiatives. However, representing the Tribal Constituency of Araku in Andhra Pradesh, I would like to emphasize that the Central Government needs to give more emphasis for building up basic infrastructure like anganwadis, schools, colleges, health centres, hospitals etc. The tribal community still do not have access to the basic facilities and the Central Government should actively support the State Governments in all the pro-poor initiatives. 

I would also like to congratulate the hon. President for mentioning the success of 'Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao' campaign. The consciousness that has come in the society due to efforts of the Government has led to a steady increase in the number of daughters. For the first time in the country, female population now outnumbers that of males and health of women has also improved considerably. Be it the Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan or the Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana, we have succeeded in saving the lives of both mother and child. About 50 percent of the beneficiaries of the Ayushman Bharat scheme are also women. From education to their career, my Government is trying to remove all obstacles for daughters. Through efforts like the construction of separate toilets for girls in the Government schools of the country or the scheme related to sanitary pads, the drop-out rate of girls has come down sharply. The Swachh Bharat Abhiyan has not only increased the dignity of women, but it has also provided them a safe environment. For the first time, savings accounts have been opened for the brighter future of crores of daughters across the country under the Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana. Many important steps have also been taken for the education of girls in the new National Education Policy.

While appreciating the Government for these initiatives, I would like to remind this august House that the AP-DISHA Bill is waiting for clearance from the Central Government. This is an important step for women's safety and I urge the Central Government to give clearance for the AP-DISHA Bill. 

Apart from that, I also thank the Government to provide 'Har Ghar Jal'. My Government has started 'Jal Jeevan Mission'. In the seven decades before the launch of the mission, water connections were available only to about 3.25 crore houses in the country. However, in these three years, about 11 crore families have been covered with piped water supply under the Jal Jeevan Mission. The poor families are benefitting the most from this scheme, and it is providing a permanent solution to their problems. In the last few years, the Government has provided pucca houses to more than three and half crore poor families. With the house comes a new self-confidence. This not only improves the present condition of the family, but also enhances the self-confidence of the child who grows up in that house. The Government has tried to relieve the poor from their worries by providing basic facilities like toilet, electricity, water, cooking gas etc. As a result, people of the country have got confidence that Government schemes and benefits actually reach the needy and 100 percent coverage or saturation is possible even in a vast country like India. 

These initiatives are necessary, but the Government should give special emphasis for developing/ implementing the Jal Jeevan Mission and provide basic facilities like toilet, electricity, water, cooking gas etc. especially in the tribal constituencies.

Lastly, while expressing my pride and happiness in witnessing a Member from the tribal community occupying the highest constitutional post in the country, I urge the Government to focus on last mile delivery and connectivity of infrastructure facilities as mentioned above and also support the State Governments especially my State of Andhra Pradesh.

With these words, I conclude my speech.

श्री परबतभाई सवाभाई पटेल (बनासकांठा): मैं राष्ट्रपति महोदया का धन्यवाद देना चाहता हूँ की उन्होंने अपने अभिभाषण में इस बात पर विशेष जोर दिया की अमृतकाल के 25 वर्ष का कालखंड स्वतंत्रता की स्वर्णिम शताब्दी और विकसित भारत के निर्माण का वक्त है और हमारे सामने स्वर्णिम युग निर्माण का अवसर है । निश्चित ही इसके लिए शत-प्रतिशत सामर्थ्य से हम सबको साथ काम करना है । हमें 2047 तक ऐसे राष्ट्र का निर्माण करना है, जिसमें अतीत का गौरव और आधुनिकता का हर स्वर्णिम अध्याय हो कुल मिलाकर हमें एक ऐसे आत्मनिर्भर भारत का निर्माण करना है जो मानवीय दायित्वों का निर्वहन करने में सक्षम हो, जहां गरीबी न हो, मध्यम वर्ग वैभव से युक्त हो, युवा समय से दो कदम आगे चलते हों । ऐसा भारत हो, जिसकी विविधता और उज्ज्वल और एकता और ज्यादा अटल हो । राष्ट्रपति महोदया ने उल्लेख किया कि शांति तभी संभव है, जब आप राजनीतिक और सैन्य रूप से सक्षम होंगे, इसलिए भारत अपनी सैन्य शक्ति को भी आधुनिक करने पर जोर दे रहा है । पूरी दुनिया इस वक्त भारत की ओर उम्मींद से देख रही है । भारत का लोकतंत्र हमेशा से समृद्ध था । एक राष्ट्र के रूप में भारत की पहचान अमर थी, अमर है और आगे भी अमर रहेगी । यह हमारा प्रयास होना ही चाहिए कि हम मुश्किल लक्ष्य रखें और उन्हें हासिल कर के दिखाएं । जो पूरी दुनिया के देश करने की सोच रहे हैं, उसे हम भारतवासी पहले कर के दिखाएं । राष्ट्रपति जी ने कहा कि सुगम्य योजना से भारत के दिव्यांगों को लाभ हुआ है, साथ ही भारत में सरकार की योजनाओं का असर वृहद हुआ है । आज युवा इनोवेशन में ताकत दिखा रहे हैं । देश में स्टार्टअप की संख्या 90 हजार के पार हो गई है । अग्निवीर योजना से भी युवाओं को फायदा होगा यह हम निकट भविष्य में देखेंगे । सरकार ने 2014 से 2022 तक 60 से ज्यादा मेडिकल कॉलेज खोले हैं । 

2014 के बाद से छात्रों के लिए ग्रैजुएट और पोस्ट ग्रैजुएट सीटें दोगुनी हो चुकी हैं । देश में इस दौरान पांच हजार से ज्यादा खोले गए हैं । इसी प्रकार फिजिकल इन्फ्रास्ट्रक्चर के कई रिकॉर्ड बने हैं । पीएम ग्राम सड़क योजना में नौ वर्षों में सड़कों का नेटवर्क दोगुना हो गया । देश की 99 प्रतिशत बस्तियां सड़क मार्ग से जुड़ चुकी हैं । राष्ट्रपति जी ने कहा कि बीते 8 सालों में देश में मेट्रो नेटवर्क में तीन गुना से अधिक बढ़ोतरी हुई है । आज 27 शहरों में ट्रेन पर काम चल रहा है । इसी प्रकार देशभर में 100 से ज्यादा नए वॉटरवे देश में ट्रासंपोर्ट सेक्टर का कायाकल्प करने में मदद करेंगे । हम जिस आधुनिक इन्फ्रास्ट्रक्चर की कामना करते थे, वो देश में बनना शुरू हुआ है । आज भारत में डिजिटल नेटवर्क है, जिससे विकसित देश भी प्रेरणा ले रहे हैं । राष्ट्रपति महोदया ने विशेष उल्लेख करते हुए कहा की देश भ्रष्टाचार से मुक्ति चाहता था और हमें उससे मुक्ति मिल रही है । आज देश की पहचान तेज विकास और दूरगामी दृष्टि से लिए गए फैसलों से हो रही है । हम दुनिया की 10वें नंबर की अर्थव्यवस्था से 5वें नंबर पर पहुंच गए हैं । यही वह नींव है, जो आने वाले 25 साल में विकसित भारत के आत्मविश्वास को बुलंद करेगी । जनधन, आधार, वन नेशन-वन राशन जैसे स्थायी सुधार किए हैं । बीते सालों में डिजिटल इंडिया के तौर पर पारदर्शी व्यवस्था तैयार की । 300 से ज्यादा योजनाओं का पैसा सीधे लाभार्थियों के खाते में पहुंचता है । अब तक 27 लाख करोड़ से ज्यादा की रकम पहुंचाई गई है । उनका यह कथां अत्यंत साराहनीय है की वर्ल्ड बैंक कहती है अपनी योजनाओं के चलते भारत कोरोना काल में लोगों को गरीबी से बचा पाया है । गरीबी हटाओ केवल नारा नहीं है, सरकार गरीब की चिंताओं का समाधान कर रही है उसे सशक्त बना रही है । गरीबी का बहुत बड़ा कारण बीमारी होती है, बीमारी से गरीब परिवार को हौसला टूट जाता है, पीढियां कर्ज में डूब जाती है ।

इसके लिए आयुष्मान योजना शुरू की गई । इसके तहत 50 करोड़ से ज्यादा देशवासी मुफ्त इलाज पा रहे हैं । राष्ट्रपति जी ने हमें आश्वश्त किया है की पीएम गरीब कल्याण अन्न योजना को हम आगे भी चलाएंगे । ये एक संवेदनशील और गरीब हितैषी सरकार की पहचान है । योजना के तहत गरीबों को मुफ्त अनाज के लिए साढ़े तीन लाख करोड़ खर्च कर चुकी है । आज इस योजना की प्रशंसा पूरे विश्व में हो रही है । अनुसूचित जाति के सामाजिक आर्थिक सशक्तिकरण के लिए कार्यक्रम चलाए जा रहे हैं । आदिवासियों के लिए जनजाति दिवस मनाया जा रहा है । आज 36 हजार से ज्यादा आदिवासी गांवों को विकसित किया जा रहा है । 400 से ज्यादा एकलव्य मॉडल स्कूल भी खोले गए  हैं । 3 हजार से ज्यादा वन धन विकास केंद्र आजीविका का साधन बने हैं । पिछड़ा वर्ग आयोग को OBC की भलाई के लिए हमारी प्रतिबद्धता को जाहिर किया । बंजारा, घुमंतू समुदाय के लिए भी बोर्ड बनाया । हर योजना के केंद्र में महिलाओं के रोजगार, सशक्तिकरण, उत्थान का भाव रहा है । जहां पुरानी मान्यताओं को तोड़ना पड़ा, वहां से भी पीछे नहीं हटे । बेटी बचाओ के तहत बेटियां बढ़ रही हैं । पहली बार पुरुषों की तुलना में महिलाओं की संख्या अधिक हुई है । उनका स्वास्थ्य भी बेहतर हुआ  है । मां-बच्चों के जीवन को बचाने में भी हम सफल रहे । आयुष्मान की 50 फीसदी लाभार्थी महिलाएं  हैं । राष्ट्रपति जी ने कहा की हम तीर्थों का विकास कर रहे हैं तो भारत दुनिया की बड़ी स्पेस पावर भी बन रहा है । भारत ने पहला प्राइवेट सैटेलाइट भी लॉन्च किया है । एक तरफ आदि शंकराचार्य, बसवेश्वर जैसे संतों के दिखाए रास्ते पर बढ़ रहे हैं, दूसरी तरफ भारत हाईटेक नॉलेज का हब बन रहा है । राष्ट्रपति जी ने कहा कि हमारा रक्षा निर्यात छह गुना हो गया है और हम सबको निश्चित ही गर्व है कि हमारी सेना में आज आईएनएस विक्रांत के रूप में पहला स्वदेशी एयरक्राफ्ट कैरियर भी शामिल हुआ है । 

उन्होंने विशेष उल्लेख किया की हमारी सरकार देश के युवाओं की शक्ति को खेलों के जरिए भी देश के सम्मान से जोड़ रही है । हमारे खिलाड़ियों ने कॉमनवेल्थ खेल से लेकर ओलंपिक और पेरा ओलंपिक अभूतपूर्व प्रदर्शन किया है । देश के कोने-कोने में ऐसी प्रतिभाओं को निखारने के लिए खेलो इंडिया गेम्स, खेलो इंडिया सेंटर्स से लेकर TOPS स्कीम तक चलाई जा रही है।?  । उन्होंने कहा कि गुलामी के हर निशान, हर मानसिकता से मुक्ति दिलाने के लिए भी मेरी सरकार निरंतर प्रयासरत है । जो कभी राजपथ था, वह अब कर्तव्य पथ बन चुका है । हमारी विरासत हमें जड़ों से जोड़ती है और हमारा विकास आसमान को छूने का हौसला देता है । इसलिए हमारी सरकार ने विरासत को मजबूती देने और विकास को प्राथमिकता देने की राह चुनी है । 

राष्ट्रपति जी का यह अभिभाषण देश के जनमानस में एक नई उर्जा का विस्तार करेगा । यह अभिभाषण सरकार की प्रतिबद्धता को दिखाता है की हमारी सरकार देशवासियों के कल्याण को लेकर पूर्णतः समर्पित है । मैं राष्ट्रपति जी को धन्यवाद देता हूँ की आपने अपने अभिभाषण के माध्यम से देश की संसद के साथ साथ समस्त देशवासियों को भी कृतज्ञ किया ।

धन्यवाद ।

श्री संतोष कुमार (पूर्णिया): मैं महामहिम राष्ट्रपति महोदया जी के अभिभषण पर धन्यवाद प्रस्ताव पर अपने विचार रखता हूं । 

राष्ट्रपति जी ने सरकार के कामकाज का काफी विस्तार से चर्चा की है । देश में सभी क्षेत्रों में जो भी कार्य सरकार ने पिछले 9 वर्षों से किया है, उसका उल्लेख है ।

· महोदय, सरकार अमृतकाल का 25 वर्ष का कालखण्ड मना रहा है । किन्तु देश की आम जनता को अमृतकाल का स्वाद महसूस नहीं हो रहा है । कारण है कि महगाई, बेरोजगारी, भ्रष्टाचार एवं वित्तिये घोटाले एवं किसानों की समस्या । पहले सरकार इन समस्याओं पर ध्यान देती, तो आज जो स्थिति है वह अमृतकाल में नहीं होता ।

· नारी शक्ति- महिला शक्तिकरण को बढ़ावा देने के लिये महिला आरक्षण को जल्द से जल्द लागू करना चाहिये ।

· आत्मनिर्भर भारत ?

· इन्फ्रास्ट्रक्चर- महोदय, मेरे संसदीय क्षेत्र पूर्णिया, बिहार का हवाई अड्डा अधर में लटका हुआ है । माननीय गृह मंत्री, जो पिछली यात्रा के दौरान पूर्णिया हवाई अड्डा को कार्याशिल बताया है किन्तु क्षोभ के साथ कहना पड़ रहा है कि पूर्णिया हवाई अड्डा वैसे ही पड़ा है । बिहार सरकार जमीन आवंटित कर दिया है । कुछ अफसर उसमें अड़ंगा लगाये हुये है, सरकार इस पर ध्यान दे और जल्द से जल्द हवाई अड्डा चालू किया जाये । सीमांचल के लिये यह काफी महत्वपूर्ण है । 

जितनी भी घोषणायें की जा रही है वह नाम को बदल कर पुरानी योजनाओं की ही रिन्पैकेजिंग हो रहा है । यह मैं देख रहा हूँ कि सरकार हर वर्ष नई-नई घोषणायें करती है और अगले वर्ष पिछले योजनाओं को भूल जाती है और नई घोषणायें हो जाती है । पहले से घोषित योजनाओं की स्थिति क्या है, कोई व्यौरा नही होता है ।

देश में कुछ राज्य विकास की दौड़ में पिछड़े हुये है । बिहार पिछले पायदान पर है । अतः बिहार को भी विकास की दौड़ में आगे बढ़ाने के लिये विशेष राज्य का दर्जा देने की मांग किया जा रहा है । किन्तु उस पर कोई चर्चा करने के लिये सरकार तैयार नही है । माननीय प्रधानमंत्री जी 2014 में बिहार की जनता से बिहार को विशेष राज्य का दर्जा देने का वादा एवं संकल्प किये थे, अब तक उसे पूरा नहीं किया गया है ।

श्रीमती रीती पाठक (सीधी): मैं इस देश के महामहिम राष्ट्रपति जी के अभिभाषण पर अपनी बात रखता हूँ । माननीय राष्ट्रपति जी का जो अभिभाषण होता है वह सरकार की नीतियों का रोडमैप होता है, जिसमे सरकार के आगामी कार्यो की रूपरेखा होती है साथ ही साथ सरकार की उपलब्धियों का ब्यौरा भी होता है । 

महामहिम राष्ट्रपति जी ने अपने अभिभाषण में कहा कि अमृतकाल का यह 25 वर्ष का कालखंड, स्वतन्त्रता की स्वर्णिम शताब्दी का, और विकसित भारत के निर्माण का कालखंड है । ये 25 वर्ष हम सबके लिए और देश के प्रत्येक नागरिक के लिए कर्तव्यों की पराकाष्ठा करके दिखाने के हैं । यह हमारे सामने युग निर्माण का अवसर है, और हमें इस अवसर के लिए शत-प्रतिशत सामर्थ्य के साथ हर क्षण कार्य करना है । 

राष्ट्रपति जी ने अपने अभिभाषण में यह भी कहा है कि हमें 2047 तक ऐसे राष्ट्र का निर्माण करना है जो अतीत के गौरव से जुड़ा हो, और जिसमे आधुनिकता का हर स्वर्णिम अध्याय हो । हमने ऐसा भारत बनाना है, जो आत्मनिर्भर हो और जो अपने मानवीय दायित्वों को पूरा करने के लिए भी समर्थ हो । 

राष्ट्रपति जी ने अपने अभिभाषण में कहा है कि हमारा भारत ऐसा भारत हो जिसमें गरीबी ण हो, जिसका मध्यम वर्ग भी वैभव युक्त हो उन्होंने ऐसे भारत कि परिकल्पना कि है जिसकी युवा शक्ति और नारिशक्ति, समाज और राष्ट्र को दिशा देने के लिए सबसे आगे खड़ी हो, जिसके युवा समय से दो कदम आगे चलते हों । ऐसा भारत जिसकी विविधता और अधिक उज्ज्वल हो और एकता और भी अधिक अटल हो ।

महामहिम ने अपने अभिभाषण में कहा कि देश के लोगों ने, जब पहली माननीय प्रधानमंत्री जी व सरकार को सेवा का अवसर दिया, तब 'सबका साथ, सबका विकास के मंत्र से हमने शुरुआत की थी । समय के साथ इसमें 'सबका विश्वास' और 'सबका प्रयास' भी जुड़ गया । यही मंत्र आज विकसित भारत के निर्माण की प्रेरणा बन चुका है । विकास के इस कर्तव्य पथ पर चलते हुए हमारी सरकार के कुछ ही महीनों में नौ वर्ष पूरे हो जाएंगे । हमारी सरकार के लगभग नौ वर्षों में भारत के लोगों ने अनेक सकारात्मक परिवर्तन पहली बार देखे हैं । सबसे बड़ा परिवर्तन यह हुआ है कि आज हर भारतीय का आत्मविश्वास शीर्ष पर है और दुनिया का भारत को देखने का नजरिया बदला है । जो भारत कभी अपनी अधिकांश समस्याओं के समाधान के लिए दूसरों पर निर्भर था, वही आज दुनिया की समस्याओं के समाधान का माध्यम बन रहा है । जिन मूल सुविधाओं के लिए देश की एक बड़ी आबादी ने दशको तक इंतजार किया, ये इन वर्षों में उसे मिली है । जिस आधुनिक इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर की हम कभी कामना करते थे, वह इन वर्षों में देश में बनना शुरू हुआ है । आज भारत में एक ऐसा डिजिटल नेटवर्क तैयार हुआ है, जिससे विकसित देश भी प्रेरणा ले रहे हैं । बड़े-बड़े घोटालों, सरकारी योजनाओं में भ्रष्टाचार की जिन समस्याओं से देश मुक्ति चाहता था, वह मुक्ति अब देश को मिल रही है । पॉलिसी पैरालिसिस की चर्चा से बाहर आकर आज देश की पहचान तेज विकास और दूरगामी दृष्टि से लिए गए फैसलों के लिए हो रही है । इसलिए हम दुनिया की 10वें नंबर की अर्थव्यवस्था से पांचवें नंबर पर पहुंच गए हैं । राष्ट्रपति जी ने कहा यही वो नींव है, जो आने वाले 25 साल में विकसित भारत के निर्माण के आत्मविश्वास को बुलंद करती है|

राष्ट्रपति महोदया जी ने भगवान बसवेश्वर के द्वारा कहे गए कथन को कहते हुए कहा कि भगवान बसवेश्वर कहा था कायकवे कैलास । अर्थात् कर्म ही पूजा है, कर्म में ही शिव हैं । उनके दिखाए मार्ग पर चलते हुए हमारी सरकार राष्ट्र निर्माण के कर्तव्य को पूरा करने में तत्परता से जुटी है ।

राष्ट्रपति महोदया जी ने कहा कि हमारी सरकार ने देशहित को सदैव सर्वोपरि रखा, नीति - रणनीति में संपूर्ण परिवर्तन कि इच्छाशक्ति दिखाई । सर्जिकल स्ट्राइक से लेकर आतंकवाद पर कठोर प्रहार तक, LoC से लेकर LAC तक हर दुस्साहस के कड़े जवाब तक, Article 370 को हटाने से लेकर तीन तलाक तक, हमारी सरकार की पहचान एक निर्णायक सरकार की रही है ।

हमारी केंद्र सरकार की विभिन्न कल्याणकारी नीतियों और साहसिक क़दमों के बल पर आज एक नए भारत का निर्माण हो रहा है और हम सभी को उसका साक्षी बनने का गौरव प्राप्त हो रहा है । आज का भारत दुनिया में नई पहचान बना रहा है, वो खाद्यानों, सुरक्षा उपकरणों, स्वास्थ्य, शिक्षा, IT, स्पेस, इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर आदि क्षेत्रों में आत्मनिर्भर बन रहा है । 

हमारी सरकार व हमारे नेता आदरणीय मोदी जी का स्पष्ट मत है कि भ्रष्टाचार लोकतंत्र का और सामाजिक न्याय का सबसे बड़ा दुश्मन है । हमारी सरकार कि बीते वर्षों मे लगातार भ्रष्टाचार के विरुद्ध युद्ध स्तर पर लगी हुई है । सरकार भारत में भ्रष्टाचार मुक्त Eco-system बनाने कि दिशा में निरंतर प्रयासरत है व फरार हुए अपराधियों कि संपत्ति जब्त करने के लिए Fugitive Economic Offenders Act भी पारित किया है । सरकारी कामों में टेन्डर और खरीद के लिए Government e- Marketplace (GeM) जैसी व्यवस्था भी बनाई है । अध्यक्ष महोदय राष्ट्रपति महोदया ने कहा है कि हमारी सरकार के द्वारा राष्ट्र निर्माण में ईमानदार योगदान देने वालों को आज विशेष सम्मान दिया जा रहा है । इनकम टैक्स रिटर्न फाइल करने में होने वाली जटिलताओं को खत्म का देश वासियों का जीवन आसान बनाया गया है । आज ITR भरने के कुछ ही दिनों के भीतर रिफन्ड मिल जाता है । जीएसटी से पारदर्शिता के साथ साथ करदाताओं की गरिमा भी सुनिश्चित हो रही है । अध्यक्ष महोदय माननीय राष्ट्रपति जी के द्वारा कही गई बात जिसमे उन्होंने कहा है कि , जब भ्रस्टाचार रुकता है और टैक्स कि पाई-पाई का सदुपयोग होता है तब हर करदाता को भी गर्व होता है यह कथन अत्यंत सराहनीय है जिसका मै अंतर्हृदय से सम्मान करती हूँ ।

डॉ. चन्द्र सेन जादौन (फिरोजाबाद): महामहिम राष्ट्रपति महोदया के अभिभाषण के धन्यवाद प्रस्ताव पर अपने विचार रखता हूं । मैं महामहिम राष्ट्रपति महोदया के अभिभाषण का समर्थन करता हूँ । मैं माननीय प्रधानमंत्री श्री नरेन्द्र मोदी जी का अति आभारी हूँ कि उन्होंने देश का गौरव बढ़ाया और G-20 की अध्यक्षता करने का सम्मानजनक स्थान पाया है । में माननीय गृहमंत्री श्री अमितशाह जी का अति आभारी हूँ कि उन्होंने प्रधानमंत्री श्री नरेन्द्र मोदी के हाथ मजबूत करते हुए धारा 370 व 35A जम्मू कश्मीर से हटाने में सहयोग किया मैं रक्षामंत्री श्री राजनाथसिंह जी का अति आभारी हूँ कि उन्होंने प्रधानमंत्री श्री नरेन्द्र मोदी जी को सहयोग करते से लेकर LAC तक चीन के हर दुस्साहस का करारा जवाब दिया प्रधानमंत्री श्री नरेन्द्र मोदी जी ने देश के युवा, महिला, किसान व उधामियों को जोड़ते हुए भारत को आत्मनिर्भर करने का भरसक प्रयास किया है । उन्होंने देश के हर गरीब, मीडियम, ओबीसी व सामान्य सभी को सबका साथ, सबका विकास, सबका विश्वास व सवका प्रियास के मूल मंत्र से जोड़ कर रखा है । समाज के अन्तिम पायदान पर खड़े व्यक्ति को हमेशा सम्मान व खुशहाली प्रदान की है । युवा कल का भविष्य है इसलिए उसके लिए इनोवेशन और Entreprenesiship पर विशेष बल दिया है । भारत दुनिया की सबसे युवा अवादी वाला देश है । आज हमारे युवा अपने इनोवेशन की ताकत दुनिया को दिखा रहे है 2015 में भारत ग्लोबल इनोवेशन इन्डैक्स में 81वें स्थान पर था, आज वह 40 वें स्थान पर है । सात वर्ष पहिले जहाँ भारत के कुछ सौ रजिस्टर्ड स्टार्ट अप्स ही थे लेकिन आज यह संख्या लगभग 90 हजार पर है ।
